commitResults.messageBody:
The template's placeholder name Duke (the Java mascot) is being replaced with Samantha, after the sentient AI in the movie Her.

Updates the class name, ASCII banner, and all Duke references in README.md and docs/README.md to match.

Add Todos, Events, Deadlines as Tasks
Add test-ui skill for scripted console UI testing
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds a project skill that runs the console sessions described in
test/ui-test-plan.md against the compiled program and checks each
command's output against its expected output, stopping at the first
mismatch. Seeds the plan with test cases for the current commands
(greet/exit, todo, deadline, event, list, mark, unmark).

Also updates AGENTS.md so future code changes update the test plan
when needed and re-run this skill automatically, instead of relying
on manual spot-checking.

Introduces a checked SamanthaException, caught once user input an unexpected command. Covers: unrecognized commands, empty todo/deadline/event descriptions, deadlines/events missing their /by, /from, or /to markers, and mark/unmark with a missing, non-numeric, or out-of-range task number.

Also adds test cases (Test 5-7) to ui-test-plan.md covering these error paths, each interleaved with a valid follow-up command to check that a rejected input doesn't corrupt the task list state.
Following the AI Guidance on CS2103T website, Opus 5 is prompted to review the exisitng ui-test-plan.md. Added more corner cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Test: Drop OOPS prefix from expected outputs
commitResults.messageBody:
The error messages no longer carry an OOPSgit add test/ui-test-plan.md! prefix, but the test
plan still expected one, so 5 of the 9 test cases failed. Aligns the
expected blocks and the two test aims that described the prefix.
